Most items were deferred to the next meeting.

what_happened.line: The Historical Commission voted to approve an expenditure to pay the Lunenburg Ledger bill for two public notices; the motion passed.
Prior minutes were approved by the chair's account, though the vote count was not audible amid audio and connection trouble affecting two members.
Updates to the demolition delay bylaw, and demolition delay requests for a Hollis Hill Road property and a Lancaster Street house, were deferred to the next meeting.
The chair will seek a second price for cemetery tree removal and brush clearing and bring it for a vote at the next meeting.
On a town survey of historic properties, members will ask a former chair about earlier survey work, and grant sources such as Mass Humanities were suggested.

why_it_matters: Cemetery work and demolition delay requests, which can affect whether older buildings are demolished, were pushed to a later meeting, so no decision on them yet.
A town survey of historic properties could be paid from the commission's budget or by outside grants, so how it is funded decides whether it touches local spending.
